title: Blocks Hurt!
description: This project makes breaking blocks a living hell, not only it insults you, but you lose a heart too!
body:
# Blocks Hurt!

**These blocks _really_ hurt!**

Blocks get broken _all the time_, but it hurts them! This gives all the blocks REVENGE! This mod makes it so whenever you break one of those poor blocks, it not only insults you, IT HURTS YOU TOO!

On a more seirous note, this is basiclly a mod that makes it so it takes 2 hearts, and gives you an insult. This makes it a cool challenge, and makes the game very hard.

This is also my first mod ever, if you didnt know!

~~This is a one file, one class mod~~

Uhhh, whats that?
